reason: A DSH Web GUI plugin that adds a GALgame-style conversation view and a visual scene editor, with user state stored in browser storage.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 会话页添加 GALgame 风格对话视图和可编辑的场景元素布局。
summaries.en: Adds a GALgame-style conversation view and an editable scene-element layout to the DSH Web GUI session page.

capabilities: modifies the DSH Web GUI session interface
adds a GAL-style conversation view with editable scene elements
stores scene layouts, assets, fonts, and reading progress in browser storage
